approval_ref: Continue improving CIRP efficiency, accuracy and adaptability across RFI, Submittal and Email content.
notes: Reproduce an unfiltered workflow inventory list that falls through to bounded evidence retrieval and model generation.
Reuse the deterministic count path and complete cached terminal-run workflow index; do not add another index or dependency.

Keep status, identifier, source, date and content filters on the ordinary evidence path and make no model or budget action.
title: List workflow inventory without a model call
objective: Answer safe run-wide RFI, Submittal and Email inventory list questions completely enough for direct use without paying a model to summarize a truncated evidence window.
